title: Understanding Linkage Types
text: Linkage types in agglomerative clustering determine how the distance between clusters is calculated. Common types include single, complete, and average linkage.

title: Single Linkage
text: Single linkage considers the shortest distance between points in different clusters. It can lead to chaining effects where clusters are elongated.

title: Complete Linkage
text: Complete linkage considers the longest distance between points in different clusters. It tends to create more compact clusters.

title: Average Linkage
text: Average linkage calculates the average distance between all pairs of points in different clusters. It balances between single and complete linkage.

title: Impact of Linkage Type
text: Consider how the choice of linkage type might affect the shape and size of the clusters formed.
